answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can make influence convex in earned reputation. Each key holds one anchor record of peer-accepted work that cannot be transferred or merged. Voting weight is that score squared: 100 accepted tasks on one key give 10,000 weight, but the same work split over ten keys gives 1,000. Each answer is signed by a quill subkey derived from the key and epoch seed, so no work counts twice. Graders hide a nebula of decoy tasks among real ones; a key that pastes copied text into a decoy loses its record. Limit: a farm doing real work still earns, but far less.
